title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
文地之文聖人之文實出一揆而
文之所在道之所在也亦心之所
在也學者文焉而推致之則心純
道純而文無不純用以經體贊元
康時酬物樹大名建丕烈一采給
於文而不窮矣是以
列聖相承咸崇科目而人材之盛政教
之隆媲美成周有不知孰前而孰
punctuated: 文、地之文、聖人之文，實出一揆。而文之所在，道之所在也，亦心之所在也。學者文焉而推致之，則心純、道純而文無不純。用以經體贊元、康時酬物、樹大名、建丕烈，一采給於文而不窮矣。是以列聖相承，咸崇科目，而人材之盛、政教之隆，媲美成周，有不知孰前而孰
translation_en: … the patterns of heaven, the patterns of earth, and the literary compositions of the sages all truly issue from a single principle. Where literary composition resides is where the Way resides, and it is also where the mind resides. When scholars engage in literary composition and extend it to the utmost, their minds become pure, their Way becomes pure, and their compositions are in every respect pure. Employed to order the state and assist the primal governance, to bring peace to the age and respond to all affairs, to establish a great reputation and achieve magnificent enterprises—all of these draw their supply from literary learning without ever being exhausted. For this reason, the successive Sacred Emperors, one after another, have all esteemed the examination system; the flourishing of men of talent and the prosperity of governance and education rival the splendor of the accomplished Zhou dynasty, so that one cannot tell which comes first and which …

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
後也猗歟休哉成化戊子歲當大
比廣東藩臬重臣禮聘儒碩以典
文衡至期合十郡士餘千人而三
試之得其文之弗畔於道者七十
有五人遵解額也小錄既成僉謂
克廉宜有一言序之惟東廣實古
綏服之外自入
聖朝沐浴清化人材儒術始埒甸侯而
===
數十年間西宼剽掠以東滋久滋
熾由是米鹽戎馬之事紛紛起矣
凡郡邑之當其衝者絃誦為之絕
響自餘亦皆弊於供億轉輸士習
不能不少間焉乙酉之秋
聖神天子不忍邊氓之顛越也爰
命太監陳瑄等率師征伐而今奉
勅提督兩廣軍務左副都御史姑蘇韓
punctuated: 後也。猗歟休哉！成化戊子，歲當大比，廣東藩臬重臣禮聘儒碩，以典文衡。至期，合十郡士餘千人而三試之，得其文之弗畔於道者七十有五人，遵解額也。小錄既成，僉謂克廉宜有一言序之。惟東廣實古綏服之外，自入聖朝，沐浴清化，人材儒術始埒甸、侯。而數十年間，西宼剽掠以東，滋久滋熾，由是米鹽戎馬之事紛紛起矣。凡郡邑之當其衝者，絃誦為之絕響；自餘亦皆弊於供億轉輸，士習不能不少間焉。乙酉之秋，聖神天子不忍邊氓之顛越也，爰命太監陳瑄等率師征伐，而今奉勅提督兩廣軍務、左副都御史姑蘇韓…
translation_en: …comes after. Oh, how glorious! In the wuzi year of the Chenghua reign (1468), the year of the triennial examination, the senior provincial administration and surveillance officials of Guangdong courteously invited eminent Confucian scholars to take charge of the literary evaluations. When the appointed time arrived, more than a thousand scholars from the ten prefectures were assembled and tested across three sessions. Seventy-five men whose essays did not deviate from the Way were selected, in compliance with the provincial quota. Once the examination record was completed, everyone agreed that I, Kelian, ought to write a few words as a preface to it. Now, eastern Guang actually lies beyond the ancient Pacified Zone (suifu). Ever since it entered our Sacred Dynasty and was bathed in its pure civilizing influence, its men of talent and Confucian learning first came to equal those of the Royal Domain (dianfu) and the Nobles' Zone (houfu). Yet over the past several decades, bandits from the west have plundered eastward, growing ever more rampant with the passage of time. Because of this, matters of provisions and warhorses arose in great confusion. In all the prefectures and counties that bore the brunt of their attacks, the sounds of string music and chanting of the classics fell silent; and even the remaining areas were all exhausted by supplying provisions and transporting goods, so that scholarly pursuits could not avoid being somewhat interrupted. In the autumn of the yiyou year (1465), the sacred and divine Son of Heaven, unable to bear the ruin and displacement of the frontier people, thereupon commanded the Grand Eunuch Chen Xuan 陳瑄 and others to lead an army on a punitive expedition, while the present Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Han [Yong 韓雍] of Gusu, who holds an Imperial Order as Supreme Commander of Military Affairs in Liangguang…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
雍實總制之遠謨雄畧功成再造
民安於廬士奮於學繼而奉
勅巡撫右副都御史四明陳濂加意作
新文教用興而左布政使江浦張
瑄右布政使天台夏塤左參政孝
感張瓚桂林鄧義右參政安成劉
鉞左參議吉水劉諭右參議三山
王英副使山陰唐彬餘姚徐海僉
===
事姑蘇戈立顧儼華亭張祚王祐
施謙鬱林陶魯莆田陳貴亦皆同
心符德安養不懈故前諸科士之
集試者大率不過七百而今實倍
之至於臨事提調監試以至百執
等内外執事罔不精白一心綱維
防範鑑別取舎惟公惟慎可以質
諸鬼神而無愧矣用是所得之文
punctuated: 雍實總制之。遠謨雄畧，功成再造，民安於廬，士奮於學。繼而奉勅巡撫右副都御史四明陳濂加意作新，文教用興。而左布政使江浦張瑄、右布政使天台夏塤、左參政孝感張瓚、桂林鄧義、右參政安成劉鉞、左參議吉水劉諭、右參議三山王英、副使山陰唐彬、餘姚徐海、僉事姑蘇戈立、顧儼、華亭張祚、王祐、施謙、鬱林陶魯、莆田陳貴，亦皆同心符德，安養不懈。故前諸科士之集試者，大率不過七百，而今實倍之。至於臨事，提調、監試以至百執等内外執事，罔不精白一心。綱維防範，鑑別取舎，惟公惟慎，可以質諸鬼神而無愧矣。用是所得之文，
translation_en: … [Han] Yong 韓雍 truly held supreme command over it. Through his far-reaching plans and heroic strategies, he achieved the功 of restoration; the common people rested peacefully in their homes, and scholars roused themselves in their studies. Subsequently, the Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator by Imperial Command, Chen Lian 陳濂 of Siming 四明, paid special attention to renewal and encouragement, whereby literary education flourished. Moreover, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner Zhang Xuan 張瑄 of Jiangpu 江浦, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Xia Xun 夏塤 of Tiantai 天台, Left Administration Vice Commissioners Zhang Zan 張瓚 of Xiaogan 孝感 and Deng Yi 鄧義 of Guilin 桂林, Right Administration Vice Commissioner Liu Yue 劉鉞 of Ancheng 安成, Left Assistant Administration Commissioner Liu Yu 劉諭 of Jishui 吉水, Right Assistant Administration Commissioner Wang Ying 王英 of Sanshan 三山, Surveillance Vice Commissioners Tang Bin 唐彬 of Shanyin 山陰 and Xu Hai 徐海 of Yuyao 餘姚, and Assistant Surveillance Commissioners Ge Li 戈立 and Gu Yan 顧儼 of Gusu 姑蘇, Zhang Zuo 張祚, Wang You 王祐, and Shi Qian 施謙 of Huating 華亭, Tao Lu 陶魯 of Yulin 鬱林, and Chen Gui 陳貴 of Putian 莆田 also all shared the same mind and matched in virtue, tirelessly pacifying and nurturing the populace. Therefore, whereas in previous examinations the scholars who gathered to be tested generally did not exceed seven hundred, this time the number was actually double that. When it came to the actual proceedings, the Proctors, Monitoring Officials, and all the inner and outer functionaries were without exception pure and united in heart. In maintaining order and precautionary regulations, and in evaluating, selecting, and rejecting, they were solely impartial and cautious, such that they could stand before ghosts and spirits without shame. Because of this, the essays obtained…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
皆氣充辭正而一純夫道即弗純
者不與焉諸士子登名薦書固華
矣繼自今偕海內之士角捷禮闈
對揚
大廷而皆有所授焉夫所授有小大
一自吾所業之文推而行之所謂
經體賛元康時酬務樹名建烈者
要皆與成周之吉人多士聯休共
美於無窮斯為科目增重而無忝
也萬有一焉曲學以阿世舍己以
從人所以負於古負於今負於
上負於下而負於克廉等亦多矣諸士
子勉旃
福建福州府懷安縣儒學教諭張克廉
謹序
punctuated:
皆氣充辭正，而一純夫道，即弗純者不與焉。諸士子登名薦書，固華矣。繼自今，偕海內之士角捷禮闈，對揚大廷，而皆有所授焉。夫所授有小大，一自吾所業之文推而行之，所謂經體賛元、康時酬務、樹名建烈者，要皆與成周之吉人多士聯休共美於無窮，斯為科目增重而無忝也。萬有一焉，曲學以阿世，舍己以從人，所以負於古、負於今、負於上、負於下，而負於克廉等亦多矣。諸士子勉旃！
福建福州府懷安縣儒學教諭張克廉謹序。
translation_en:
…are all full of vigor and upright in expression, wholly pure in the Way; any that were not pure were not included. For the scholars to have their names entered on the list of recommended candidates is indeed glorious. From this point onward, they will compete for victory in the Metropolitan Examination alongside scholars from across the realm, respond to the Sovereign in the Great Court, and all receive official appointments. Now, whether those appointments are great or small, if in every case they extend and put into practice the learning of the texts they have mastered—what were earlier called ordering the state's institutions and assisting the primal governance, bringing peace to the age and meeting the demands of affairs, and establishing a name and achieving meritorious deeds—then in sum they will share endless glory and beauty alongside the "good men" and "multitude of scholars" of the accomplished Zhou dynasty. Thus will they add weight to the examination system and bring no disgrace to it. Should there be even one in ten thousand who twists his learning to flatter the world or abandons his own principles to follow others, he will have failed antiquity, failed the present, failed his superiors, and failed his inferiors—and he will have failed Kelian and his colleagues to a great extent as well. Scholars, exert yourselves!

Respectfully prefaced by Zhang Kelian 張克廉, Instructor of the Confucian School of Huai'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian.

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
第一場
四書
大宰問於子貢曰夫子聖者與何其多
能也子貢曰固天縱之將聖又多能
也
子庶民則百姓勸來百工則財用足柔
遠人則四方歸之懷諸侯則天下畏
之
===
孔子登東山而小魯登太山而小天下
故觀於海者難為水遊於聖人之門
者難為言
易
九二之孚有喜也
進得位往有功也進以正可以正邦也
初六藉用白茅无咎子曰苟錯諸地而
可矣藉之用茅何咎之有慎之至也
punctuated:
第一場

四書
大宰問於子貢曰：「夫子聖者與？何其多能也？」子貢曰：「固天縱之將聖，又多能也。」
子庶民，則百姓勸；來百工，則財用足；柔遠人，則四方歸之；懷諸侯，則天下畏之。
孔子登東山而小魯，登太山而小天下。故觀於海者難為水，遊於聖人之門者難為言。

易
九二之孚，有喜也。
進得位，往有功也。進以正，可以正邦也。
「初六，藉用白茅，无咎。」子曰：「苟錯諸地而可矣，藉之用茅，何咎之有？慎之至也。
translation_en:
First Session

The Four Books (Sishu)
1. The Great Officer asked Zigong, "Is the Master a sage? Why is it that he has so many abilities?" Zigong replied, "Indeed Heaven has endowed him so that he is a great sage, and moreover he has many abilities."
2. By treating the common people as one's children, the hundred surnames are encouraged; by attracting all kinds of artisans, wealth and resources are made sufficient; by dealing gently with men from afar, people from the four quarters will turn to him; by cherishing the feudal lords, the whole world will hold him in awe.
3. Confucius ascended the Eastern Mountain and Lu seemed small to him; he ascended Mount Tai and all under Heaven seemed small to him. Therefore, for one who has gazed upon the sea, it is difficult for any other water to seem great; and for one who has roamed within the gate of the sage, it is difficult for any other words to seem impressive.

The Book of Changes (Yi)
1. The sincerity of the Nine in the Second Place brings joy.
2. Advancing and attaining its proper position, its going forward brings merit. Advancing with rectitude, one can rectify the state.
3. "Six at the Beginning: Using white cogongrass for a mat beneath, there is no blame." The Master said, "If one simply placed the offerings on the ground, that would suffice. When one spreads white cogongrass beneath them, what blame could there be? This is the utmost of caution. …"

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
夫茅之為物薄而用可重也慎斯術
也以往其无所失矣
動萬物者莫疾乎雷撓萬物者莫疾乎
風燥萬物者莫熯乎火說萬物者莫
說乎澤潤萬物者莫潤乎水終萬物
始萬物者莫盛乎艮故水火相逮雷
風不相悖山澤通氣
書
===
天工人其代之天叙有典勅我五典五
惇哉天秩有禮自我五禮有庸哉同
寅協恭和衷哉天命有德五服五章
哉天討有罪五刑五用哉政事懋哉
懋哉天聰明自我民聰明天明畏自
我民明威達于上下敬哉有土
其不能誠于小民今休王不敢後用顧
畏于民碞王來紹上帝自服于土中
punctuated:
夫茅之為物薄，而用可重也。慎斯術也以往，其无所失矣。」
「動萬物者，莫疾乎雷；撓萬物者，莫疾乎風；燥萬物者，莫熯乎火；說萬物者，莫說乎澤；潤萬物者，莫潤乎水；終萬物始萬物者，莫盛乎艮。故水火相逮，雷風不相悖，山澤通氣。」

《書》
「天工人其代之。天叙有典，勅我五典五惇哉！天秩有禮，自我五禮有庸哉！同寅協恭，和衷哉！天命有德，五服五章哉！天討有罪，五刑五用哉！政事懋哉懋哉！天聰明，自我民聰明；天明畏，自我民明威。達于上下，敬哉有土！」
「其不能誠于小民，今休。王不敢後，用顧畏于民碞。王來紹上帝，自服于土中。
translation_en:
…Now thatch as a substance is slight, yet its use can be weighty. If one goes forwardbeing cautious with this method, one will suffer no loss.”
“In stirring the myriad things, nothing is swifter than thunder; in bending the myriad things, nothing is swifter than wind; in drying the myriad things, nothing is more parching than fire; in gladdening the myriad things, nothing is more gladdening than the marsh; in moistening the myriad things, nothing is more moistening than water; in bringing the myriad things to an end and bringing the myriad things to a beginning, nothing is more flourishing than Gen [Keeping Still / the Mountain]. Therefore water and fire reach each other, thunder and wind do not conflict with each other, and mountain and marsh communicate their breaths.”

Book of Documents (Shu)
“The work of Heaven—it is men who carry it out in its stead. Heaven has established the social relationships with their moral principles; let us set right our five relationships and give full thickness to all five! Heaven has instituted the ceremonies according to rank; let our five ceremonies be constantly observed! Let us share a common reverence and united respect, harmonizing the moral nature! Heaven bestows office on the virtuous; let there be the five vestments with their five emblems of distinction! Heaven punishes the guilty; let there be the five punishments in their fivefold application! In matters of governance, be diligent, be diligent! Heaven’s hearing and seeing proceed from our people’s hearing and seeing; Heaven’s discerning and awesomeness proceed from our people’s discerning and awesomeness. There is communication between above and below; be reverent, you who possess the land!”
“Let him not fail to bring harmony to the common people, and so achieve present blessing. Let the King not dare to be remiss, but have regard and awe for the perilousness of the people. Let the King come to succeed the Supreme Ruler and personally undertake his duties in the center of the land. …

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
旦曰其作大邑其自時配皇天毖祀
于上下其自時中乂王厥有成命治
民今休
自作不和爾惟和哉爾室不睦爾惟和
哉爾邑克明爾惟克勤乃事爾尚不
忌于凶德亦則以穆穆在乃位克閱
于乃邑謀介
惟察惟法其審克之
===
詩
顯允方叔征伐玁狁蠻荆来威
受天之祜四方来賀
何求為我以戾庶正
皇皇后帝皇祖后稷享以騂犧是饗是
宜降福既多周公皇祖亦其福女秋
而載嘗夏而楅衡白牡騂剛犧尊将
将毛炰胾羹籩豆大房萬舞洋洋孝
punctuated:
旦曰：「其作大邑，其自時配皇天，毖祀于上下，其自時中乂。王厥有成命，治民今休。」
自作不和，爾惟和哉；爾室不睦，爾惟和哉。爾邑克明，爾惟克勤乃事；爾尚不忌于凶德，亦則以穆穆在乃位，克閱于乃邑謀介。
惟察惟法，其審克之。
詩：
顯允方叔，征伐玁狁，蠻荆来威。
受天之祜，四方来賀。
何求為我，以戾庶正。
皇皇后帝，皇祖后稷，享以騂犧，是饗是宜，降福既多，周公皇祖，亦其福女。秋而載嘗，夏而楅衡，白牡騂剛，犧尊将将，毛炰胾羹，籩豆大房，萬舞洋洋，孝
translation_en:
…Dan (旦, the Duke of Zhou) said: "Let a great city be built, and from this time let him be the correlate of August Heaven; let him carefully attend to the sacrifices to the spirits above and below, and from this center let him govern cleanly. The King, having thus fulfilled his mandate, in governing the people will now have auspicious rest."

When they create discord among themselves, do you bring them into harmony; when their families are not at peace, do you bring them into harmony! When your cities are able to be illustrious, you will have proved yourself diligent in your affairs; and if you do not hate the evil-doers [or: do not neglect to beware of evil], then by dwelling in your position with solemn reverence, you will be able to inspect your cities and take counsel for assistance.

Through careful observation and adherence to the law, examine into the cases and do your utmost in them.

Book of Odes (詩經, Shijing):

Illustrious and true is Fang Shu (方叔), who went to smite the Xianyun (玁狁), and the Man-tribes of Jing (蠻荆) came in awe.

Receiving the blessing of Heaven, from the four quarters they come to offer congratulations.

What does it seek for me, so as to settle the heads of all the departments?

Most great and sovereign God, and our great ancestor Hou Ji (后稷)—we offer to them the red victim; they enjoy it, they approve it, and send down abundant blessings. The Duke of Zhou (周公), your great ancestor, will also bless you. In autumn comes the Chang (嘗) sacrifice, and in summer the cross-bars are fixed to the horns of the victims; they are the white bull and the red one; there are the bull-figured goblets in their majesty; the singed pig, the roast meat, the minced meat, and the soups; the bamboo and wooden dishes, and the large stand; and the Wan (萬) dance in all its grandness. The filial…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
孫有慶
春秋
宋人伐鄭圍長葛〔隱公五年〕冬宋人取長
葛〔隱公六年〕
九月丁卯子同生〔桓公六年〕甲午衛侯衎復
歸于衛〔襄公二十六年〕吳子使札来聘〔襄公二〕
〔十九年〕取鄫〔昭公四年〕
單伯會齊侯宋公衛侯鄭伯于鄄〔莊公十四〕
===
〔年〕齊侯宋公陳侯衛侯鄭伯會于鄄
〔莊公十五年〕宋人齊人衛人伐鄭會齊
侯宋公陳侯衛侯鄭伯許男滑伯滕

punctuated:
孫有慶。

Record of Rites (Liji)

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
考禮正刑一德以尊于天子
親者屬也自仁率親等而上之至于祖
自義率袒順而下之至于禰是故人
道親親也
不興其藝不能樂學故君子之於學也
藏焉脩焉息焉遊焉夫然故安其學
而親其師樂其友而信其道
仁有三與仁同功而異情與仁同功其
===
仁未可知也與仁同過然後其仁可
知也仁者安仁知者利仁畏罪者強
仁
第二塲
論
聖人教人有定本
詔誥表內科一道
擬漢文帝親率羣臣勸農賜民今年田租之半詔〔嘉靖元年二月十六日〕
punctuated:
考禮、正刑、一德，以尊于天子。
親者，屬也。自仁率親，等而上之至于祖；自義率袒，順而下之至于禰。是故人道親親也。
不興其藝，不能樂學。故君子之於學也，藏焉，脩焉，息焉，遊焉。夫然，故安其學而親其師，樂其友而信其道。
仁有三，與仁同功而異情。與仁同功，其仁未可知也；與仁同過，然後其仁可知也。仁者安仁，知者利仁，畏罪者強仁。

第二塲
論：
聖人教人有定本。

詔誥表內科一道：
擬漢文帝親率羣臣勸農賜民今年田租之半詔〔嘉靖元年二月十六日〕
translation_en:
"To examine ritual, rectify punishments, and unify virtue, so as to honor the Son of Heaven."

"Kinship means connection. Proceeding from benevolence to follow affection for kin, one ascends by degrees up to the distant ancestor; proceeding from righteousness to follow the distant ancestor [?], one descends in order down to the deceased father. Therefore, the way of humanity is to feel affection for one's kin."

"If one does not take delight in the arts, one cannot find joy in learning. Therefore, in his pursuit of learning, the superior man stores it up, cultivates it, rests in it, and wanders in it. Being thus, he is at ease in his learning and feels affection for his teacher, takes joy in his friends and has faith in his Way."

"There are three kinds of benevolence, which achieve the same merit as benevolence but differ in motivation. When men achieve the same merit as benevolence, their benevolence cannot yet be known; when they make the same errors as benevolence, only then can their benevolence be known. The benevolent man rests in benevolence, the wise man finds profit in benevolence, and he who fears punishment forces himself to practice benevolence."

Second Session

Discourse:
"In teaching people, the sages have a fixed foundation."

Imperial Edict, Imperial Mandate, or Memorial (choose one):
"A proposed imperial edict for Emperor Wen of the Han personally leading the officials to encourage agriculture and granting the people a remission of half of this year's land tax" [Sixteenth day of the second month of the first year of the Jiajing era (1522) [?]]…

text:

擬唐考第李綱盡忠孫伏伽誠直為第
一誥

Question: In the Way of humanity, nothing is greater than the Five Human Relationships. Since antiquity, sage emperors and enlightened kings, in ruling and instructing All Under Heaven, have without exception made this their foremost task. Humbly reflecting on how Our Dynasty received …

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
天明命
列聖繼作文治大興薄海内外聲教遠暨而
人倫無不明矣伏遇
宣宗章皇帝體道謙沖游心典籍又於萬幾
之暇采古今之嘉言善行有關於倫
理者萃以成編名曰五倫書而
頒布天下以示勸其立教垂訓之意盖與
列聖同一心也欽誦所載君道之目五十而
===
以聖德聖學為之冠以聖德言之有
如天如神如日如雲者矣其視克寬
克仁克明克忠者為孰優有臨下以
簡御衆以寬者矣其視不泄邇不忘
遠者為孰賢以聖學言之有受丹書
訪洪範者矣與開學館而銳情經術
者孰與耶有舊學甘盤克邁乃訓者
矣與在軍旅而手不釋卷者孰勤耶
punctuated: 天明命，列聖繼作，文治大興，薄海内外，聲教遠暨，而人倫無不明矣。伏遇宣宗章皇帝，體道謙沖，游心典籍，又於萬幾之暇，采古今之嘉言善行有關於倫理者，萃以成編，名曰《五倫書》，而頒布天下，以示勸。其立教垂訓之意，盖與列聖同一心也。欽誦所載，君道之目五十，而以聖德、聖學為之冠。以聖德言之，有「如天如神，如日如雲」者矣，其視「克寬克仁，克明克忠」者為孰優？有「臨下以簡，御衆以寬」者矣，其視「不泄邇，不忘遠」者為孰賢？以聖學言之，有受《丹書》、訪《洪範》者矣，與開學館而銳情經術者孰與耶？有「舊學甘盤」、「克邁乃訓」者矣，與在軍旅而手不釋卷者孰勤耶？
translation_en:
… the bright mandate of Heaven, the successive sage emperors arose one after another, cultural governance flourished greatly, moral prestige and instruction reached far both within and beyond the seas, and none of the human relationships failed to be made clear. We have humbly encountered Emperor Xuanzong Zhang (the Xuande Emperor), who embodied the Way in modest humility and let his mind roam among the canonical books; moreover, in the leisure from his myriad state affairs, he gathered fine words and good deeds from antiquity to the present that pertain to moral principles, compiling them into a work entitled Book of the Five Human Relationships (Wulun shu), which he promulgated throughout the realm by way of encouragement. His intention in establishing teaching and handing down instruction was indeed of one mind with that of the successive sage emperors.

Humbly reading what is recorded therein: the headings under the Way of the Ruler number fifty, and Sage Virtue and Sage Learning stand at their head. Speaking of Sage Virtue, there is that described as "like Heaven and like the spirits, like the sun and like the clouds"; compared with being "able to be magnanimous and able to be benevolent, able to be discerning and able to be loyal," which is superior? There is "approaching inferiors with simplicity and governing the multitude with leniency"; compared with "not treating the near with familiarity and not forgetting the distant," which is worthier? Speaking of Sage Learning, there is he who received the Cinnabar Writing (Danshu) and inquired into the Great Plan (Hongfan); how does that compare with opening an academy and devoting passionate energy to classical scholarship? There are those of whom it is said that he "formerly studied under Gan Pan" and was "able to advance upon his instruction"; compared with never putting down a scroll even while on military campaign, which is more diligent? …

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
臣道之目四十有八而以輔德經國
為之首以輔德言之無怠無荒四夷
来王謨訓切矣其視作書賦詩以戒
王者為何如脩德脩刑動天以誠規
戒深矣其視手疏八事以諫帝者又
何如以經國言之决九川弼五服厥
功茂矣方之經營四方而告成于王
者又孰愈耶辨方正位體國經野其
===
績偉矣較之出納王命而為王喉舌
者又孰勝耶三十七字以詔後人父
道善矣視以田十頃桑千株遺子孫
者同歟異歟清朝履霜援琴而歌子
道盡矣視畊歷山號旻天而終身怨
慕者是歟非歟寧忤帝旨不以貴戚
易陋妻夫道之善也婦能却金璧之
聘辭夫人之位而守節不渝者心豈
punctuated: 臣道之目四十有八，而以輔德、經國為之首。以輔德言之，「無怠無荒，四夷来王」，謨訓切矣，其視作書賦詩以戒王者為何如？「脩德脩刑，動天以誠」，規戒深矣，其視手疏八事以諫帝者又何如？以經國言之，「决九川，弼五服」，厥功茂矣，方之經營四方而告成于王者又孰愈耶？「辨方正位，體國經野」，其績偉矣，較之出納王命而為王喉舌者又孰勝耶？三十七字以詔後人，父道善矣，視以田十頃、桑千株遺子孫者同歟異歟？清朝履霜，援琴而歌，子道盡矣，視畊歷山、號旻天而終身怨慕者是歟非歟？寧忤帝旨，不以貴戚易陋妻，夫道之善也；婦能却金璧之聘，辭夫人之位，而守節不渝者，心豈…
translation_en: The subheadings under the Way of the Minister number forty-eight, with Assisting in Virtue and Ordering the State placed at their head. Speaking in terms of Assisting in Virtue: "Do not be idle, do not be negligent, and the four barbarous tribes will come to acknowledge your kingship"—such counsels and instructions were earnest indeed; how do they compare with composing treatises and presenting odes to admonish the king? "Cultivate virtue and regulate punishments, moving Heaven through sincerity"—such remonstrances were profound indeed; how again do they compare with personally drafting a memorial on eight matters to admonish the Emperor? Speaking in terms of Ordering the State: "Opening up the nine rivers and assisting in the establishment of the five domains"—those achievements were abundant indeed; compared with bringing order to the four quarters and reporting completion to the king, which is superior? "Determining directions and fixing positions, delineating the capital and dividing the countryside"—those accomplishments were magnificent indeed; compared with issuing and receiving the royal commands and serving as the king's throat and tongue, which excels? Leaving a thirty-seven-character testament to instruct one's descendants—such is excellence in the Way of the Father; compared with bequeathing ten qing of fields and eight hundred [here: a thousand] mulberry trees to one's sons and grandsons, are they the same or different? Treading on the morning frost in the clear dawn, taking up the zither and singing—such is the fulfillment of the Way of the Son; compared with plowing on Mount Li, crying out to compassionate Heaven, and longing in lifelong remorseful affection, are they right or wrong? Preferring to defy the Emperor's decree rather than replace a humble wife with an imperial relative—such is excellence in the Way of the Husband; as for a wife who could reject betrothal gifts of gold and jade, decline the rank of royal consort, and preserve her chastity without wavering, how could her heart…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
異乎寧違父命不以寵禄傷天倫弟
道之善也兄能輕千乗之國效泰伯
之讓而秉德不回者心何厚乎至若
朋友之倫有同舉孝廉而自許以膠
漆者有同游太學而相托以死生者
有念及其親以柳易播而不計其利害
者有三仕三逐三戰三北而不以其
為柔怯者是又友道之善而凡學者
===
皆不可以不知也諸士子游學庠序
欽服
聖訓有日矣其詳言之毋諉曰請俟更僕
問六經四書之所載微辭奧義廣大悉
備未可以一二究其涯涘姑舉其槩
評之可乎故法象莫大於天地而有
陰陽剛柔之妙陰陽莫妙於鬼神而
不無費隱小大之别上天所賦之謂
punctuated:
異乎？寧違父命，不以寵禄傷天倫，弟道之善也；兄能輕千乗之國，效泰伯之讓，而秉德不回者，心何厚乎？至若朋友之倫，有同舉孝廉而自許以膠漆者，有同游太學而相托以死生者，有念及其親，以柳易播，而不計其利害者，有三仕三逐、三戰三北，而不以其為柔怯者，是又友道之善，而凡學者皆不可以不知也。諸士子游學庠序，欽服聖訓有日矣，其詳言之，毋諉曰「請俟更僕」。

問：六經、四書之所載，微辭奧義，廣大悉備，未可以一二究其涯涘，姑舉其槩評之，可乎？故法象莫大於天地，而有陰陽剛柔之妙；陰陽莫妙於鬼神，而不無費隱小大之别。上天所賦之謂…
translation_en:
…different? Preferring to disobey a father's command rather than harm natural family bonds for the sake of favored emolument exemplifies excellence in the way of a younger brother; and when an elder brother can lightly regard a state of a thousand chariots, emulating the yielding of Taibo and holding fast to virtue without wavering, how generous is his heart! As for the human relationship of friends: there were those recommended together as Filial and Incorrupt (xiaolian) who pledged themselves to a bond like glue and lacquer; those who studied together at the National University (Taixue) and entrusted one another with matters of life and death; one who, out of concern for his friend's parent, offered to exchange Liuzhou for Bozhou without reckoning the personal advantage or harm; and one who, when his friend thrice took office and was thrice dismissed, and thrice went to battle and was thrice routed, did not regard him as weak or cowardly. These, too, exemplify excellence in the way of friends, of which no scholar may remain ignorant. You gentlemen have studied in the local schools and reverently submitted to the Sage's instructions for many days now. Explain these matters in full detail, and do not excuse yourselves by saying, "Please wait until the attendants are changed."

Question: What is recorded in the Six Classics (Liujing) and the Four Books (Sishu) comprises subtle words and profound meanings, vast and complete in every respect. One cannot exhaust their boundless limits by citing just one or two points, yet may we provisionally raise their general outlines to evaluate them? Thus, among models and images none is greater than Heaven and Earth, yet they possess the subtlety of yin and yang, the firm and the yielding; between yin and yang nothing is more subtle than ghosts and spirits, yet they are not without distinctions of the广泛 (far-reaching) and the hidden, the small and the great. What is endowed by High Heaven is called…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
命何以有正不正之分人物所受之
謂性何以有謂不謂之異性率於已
之謂道而一二五之目何所指耶道
得於心之謂德而三六九之類何所
在耶人道莫大於仁義而何以見其
有健順分錯之妙制作莫大於禮樂
而何以見其有本末偏全之論誠乃
眞實無妄之理何以有天道人道之
===
分忠恕盡已推已之謂何以有以天
以人之別君臣人道之大倫而皇帝
王伯之殊號公卿大夫士之殊名與
其所各當盡之道又何所辨而何所
在耶父子天屬之至親而嫡繼慈養
之異等大宗小宗之異禰與其所當
為之服又何所別而何所處耶凡若
此者皆天理人道之大端而凡學者
punctuated: 命，何以有正不正之分？人物所受之謂性，何以有謂不謂之異？性率於已之謂道，而一二五之目何所指耶？道得於心之謂德，而三六九之類何所在耶？人道莫大於仁義，而何以見其有健順分錯之妙？制作莫大於禮樂，而何以見其有本末偏全之論？誠乃眞實無妄之理，何以有天道人道之分？忠恕盡已推已之謂，何以有以天以人之別？君臣，人道之大倫，而皇、帝、王、伯之殊號，公、卿、大夫、士之殊名，與其所各當盡之道，又何所辨而何所在耶？父子，天屬之至親，而嫡、繼、慈、養之異等，大宗、小宗之異禰，與其所當為之服，又何所別而何所處耶？凡若此者，皆天理人道之大端，而凡學者
translation_en: …decree (ming); why is there a distinction between what is regular and what is irregular? What human beings and things receive is called nature (xing); why is there a difference between what is called nature and what is not called nature? Following one's nature in oneself is called the Way (dao); to what do the headings of the One, the Two, and the Five refer? Obtaining the Way in one's heart-mind is called virtue (de); where are the categories of the Three, the Six, and the Nine to be found? In the Way of Man, nothing is greater than benevolence (ren) and righteousness (yi); how do we see the subtlety of their vigor and docility, division and alternation? Among human institutions, nothing is greater than rites and music; how do we see the discussions regarding their roots and branches, partiality and completeness? Sincerity (cheng) is the principle of truth and freedom from falsehood; why is there a division between the Way of Heaven and the Way of Man? Loyalty (zhong) and reciprocity (shu) mean exerting oneself to the utmost and extending oneself to others; why is there a distinction between acting by Heaven and acting by Man? Ruler and minister constitute the great human relationship; regarding the different titles of August One (huang), Emperor (di), King (wang), and Hegemon (ba), the different designations of Duke (gong), Minister (qing), Grand Master (dafu), and Servitor (shi), as well as the Way that each ought to fulfill—how are they distinguished and wherein do they lie? Father and son are the closest of natural kin; regarding the different grades of principal mother (di), stepmother (ji), foster mother (ci), and adoptive mother (yang), the different ancestral shrines (ne) of the major lineage (dazong) and minor lineages (xiaozong), as well as the mourning garments that ought to be worn for them—how are they differentiated and how are they managed? All such matters are the great fundamentals of Heavenly Principle and the Way of Man, which all scholars…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
不可以不講也其詳言之
問考論古人行事之跡不越乎載籍而
載籍之辭未可盡信也同時而仕同
堂而語十人書之其事各異盖聞見
有詳畧文辭有工拙意向有高下坐
是失其真者亦多矣况於數百年或
千餘歳之相遠耳不聞其言目不睹
其事意揣心構以補其所不足而增
===
其所未備則其失真不既多矣乎甞
觀載籍與儒先君子之論未甞不衆
難填胸羣疑滿腹也姑舉其一二顯
明而易斷者以商確焉燕昭王築臺
招賢而樂毅自魏國来未幾至上将
軍并護趙楚韓魏之兵以伐齊連下
七十餘城而即墨與莒不拔昔人謂
其庶幾湯武又謂其行王道之過漢
punctuated:
不可以不講也。其詳言之。

問：考論古人行事之跡，不越乎載籍，而載籍之辭未可盡信也。同時而仕，同堂而語，十人書之，其事各異。盖聞見有詳畧，文辭有工拙，意向有高下，坐是失其真者亦多矣。况於數百年或千餘歳之相遠，耳不聞其言，目不睹其事，意揣心構，以補其所不足而增其所未備，則其失真不既多矣乎？甞觀載籍與儒先君子之論，未甞不衆難填胸、羣疑滿腹也。姑舉其一二顯明而易斷者以商確焉。燕昭王築臺招賢，而樂毅自魏國来，未幾至上将軍，并護趙、楚、韓、魏之兵以伐齊，連下七十餘城，而即墨與莒不拔。昔人謂其庶幾湯、武，又謂其行王道之過。漢
translation_en:
…cannot neglect to discuss. Explain this in detail.

Question: In examining and discussing the deeds of the ancients, one cannot go beyond written records, yet the accounts in written records cannot be entirely believed. When men serve at the same time and converse in the same hall, if ten people write it down, their accounts of the events will each differ. This is because what they hear and see varies in detail, their literary expression varies in skill, and their intentions vary in quality; because of this, there are many cases in which the truth is lost. How much more so when separated by several hundred or over a thousand years, when the ears do not hear their words and the eyes do not witness their deeds, and writers surmise in their minds and fabricate in their thoughts to supply what is lacking and add what is incomplete—are not the losses of truth even greater? Whenever I have examined the written records and the discussions of earlier Confucian gentlemen, my chest has never failed to be filled with numerous difficulties and my mind brimming with a host of doubts. Let me provisionally cite one or two clear and easily judged cases to deliberate upon. King Zhao of Yan 燕昭王 built a terrace to summon worthy men, and Yue Yi 樂毅 came from the state of Wei 魏. Before long he rose to Upper General (shang jiangjun), and jointly commanded the troops of Zhao 趙, Chu 楚, Han 韓, and Wei 魏 to attack Qi 齊, capturing over seventy cities in succession, while only Jimo 即墨 and Ju 莒 were not taken. Men of the past said that he came close to Tang 湯 and Wu 武, and also said that his fault lay in practicing the Kingly Way. In the Han…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
昭烈三顧草廬諸葛亮以布衣起未
幾身都將相欲竭股肱忠正之節以
興漢壽止五十四歲而興復大業不
就昔人謂其亞匹管蕭又謂其非將
畧之長夫湯武與管蕭三尺之童亦
知其懸絕王道與將畧一藝之士亦
識其小大借使樂毅與孔明有優劣
高下優而幾湯武劣而亞管蕭相去
===
何遠歟高而行王道下而短將畧相
遠何甚歟雖然孔明養高隆中之日
嘗自比管仲樂毅而時人莫之許也
則是孔明自附太高而所謂不及樂
毅之言已出於當時而非獨後世矣
諸生博古待問於二人行跡熟之久
矣必舉其立論之人與所論之當否
而折衷以對母徒諉曰知人其難
punctuated: 昭烈三顧草廬，諸葛亮以布衣起，未幾身都將相，欲竭股肱忠正之節以興漢，壽止五十四歲而興復大業不就。昔人謂其亞匹管、蕭，又謂其非將畧之長。夫湯、武與管、蕭，三尺之童亦知其懸絕；王道與將畧，一藝之士亦識其小大。借使樂毅與孔明有優劣高下，優而幾湯、武，劣而亞管、蕭，相去何遠歟？高而行王道，下而短將畧，相遠何甚歟？雖然，孔明養高隆中之日，嘗自比管仲、樂毅，而時人莫之許也。則是孔明自附太高，而所謂不及樂毅之言，已出於當時，而非獨後世矣。諸生博古待問，於二人行跡熟之久矣，必舉其立論之人與所論之當否，而折衷以對，母徒諉曰「知人其難」。
translation_en: … [Emperor] Zhaolie [of Han, i.e. Liu Bei 劉備] paid three visits to the thatched cottage, and Zhuge Liang 諸葛亮 rose from the status of a commoner. Before long, he held the offices of both general and chief minister in his own person, wishing to exhaust his loyal and upright integrity as the monarch's right-hand man in order to revive the Han. Yet his lifespan reached only fifty-four sui, and the great enterprise of restoration was not accomplished. Commentators of the past said that he was second only to or a match for Guan [Zhong 管仲] and Xiao [He 蕭何], while also saying that military strategy as a general was not his strong suit. Now, as for the vast disparity between Tang 湯 and Wu 武 on the one hand and Guan and Xiao on the other, even a child three feet tall knows it; and as for the relative scale of the Kingly Way versus military strategy, even a scholar of a single skill recognizes which is great and which is small. Even supposing that Yue Yi 樂毅 and Kongming 孔明 [Zhuge Liang] differed in superiority and inferiority, or in loftiness and lowness—for the superior one to nearly equal Tang and Wu, and the inferior one to be ranked just after Guan and Xiao, how far apart they would be! For the lofty one to practice the Kingly Way, and the lower one to be deficient even in military strategy, how extreme the distance between them would be! Even so, in the days when Kongming was cultivating lofty seclusion in Longzhong 隆中, he once compared himself to Guan Zhong and Yue Yi, yet none of his contemporaries granted him that. This would mean that Kongming rated himself too highly, and the assessment that he did not measure up to Yue Yi already emerged in his own time, and not solely in later ages. You students, broadly learned in antiquity and awaiting questions, have long been thoroughly familiar with the deeds of these two men. You must cite the authors of these assessments and evaluate whether their arguments are sound or not, weighing them judiciously in your reply; do not merely shirk the question by saying, "How difficult it is to truly know a man!"

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
問士之所尚誠實恬退推遜清廉而已
故古人之調美風俗崇重名節有不
緩於是也厥後有戒欺誕疾奔競之
詩有黜攘奪戒貪墨之舉故當時人
皆勵行丕振士風所謂白首事上不
忍見欺十九登第不忍增年不預宴
集直陳其情私入市肆直言其故此
誠實之風著矣年方強仕請解機務
===
年未知命表求掛冠父任執政不就
廷試禮部第一不肯自陳此恬退之
風盛矣至若試大名而讓人居先薦
萊州而謙己居次以至自謂駑朽請
薦相才自謂非材久妨賢路此推遜
之風然也位宰執而無地樓臺知成
都而屏去龜鶴以至歸自南海不載
一物歸自西蜀僅有數卷此清廉之
punctuated: 問：士之所尚，誠實、恬退、推遜、清廉而已。故古人之調美風俗，崇重名節，有不緩於是也。厥後有戒欺誕、疾奔競之詩，有黜攘奪、戒貪墨之舉，故當時人皆勵行，丕振士風。所謂白首事上，不忍見欺；十九登第，不忍增年；不預宴集，直陳其情；私入市肆，直言其故：此誠實之風著矣。年方強仕，請解機務；年未知命，表求掛冠；父任執政，不就廷試；禮部第一，不肯自陳：此恬退之風盛矣。至若試大名而讓人居先，薦萊州而謙己居次，以至自謂駑朽，請薦相才，自謂非材，久妨賢路：此推遜之風然也。位宰執而無地樓臺，知成都而屏去龜鶴，以至歸自南海，不載一物，歸自西蜀，僅有數卷：此清廉之
translation_en: Question: What scholars esteem is nothing other than sincerity and honesty, tranquil retirement, deferential modesty, and pure integrity. Therefore, when the ancients harmonized and beautified customs and esteemed moral reputation, they were not negligent in these matters. Later on, there were poems warning against deceit and absurdity and detesting competitive careerism, as well as measures dismissing those who seized and contended and warning against greed and corruption; thus, people of that time all strove to cultivate their conduct and greatly revitalized the ethos of the literati. As for what is told of serving the sovereign until white-haired and not bearing to deceive him; passing the examination at nineteen and not bearing to pad one's age; not attending a banquet gathering and candidly stating the truth; and privately entering a marketplace shop and frankly explaining the reason—in these, the ethos of sincerity and honesty was manifest. Being just forty years of age and requesting to be relieved of state affairs; not yet having reached fifty and submitting a memorial begging to hang up one's official cap; declining to sit for the Palace Examination because one's father served as a Chief Councilor; and ranking first in the Ministry of Rites examination yet refusing to put oneself forward—in these, the ethos of tranquil retirement flourished. As for taking the examination in Daming and yielding first place to another, or being recommended from Laizhou and modestly placing oneself second, and even calling oneself a worn-out nag and asking to recommend someone of ministerial talent, or calling oneself untalented and long blocking the path of the worthy—such was the ethos of deferential modesty. Holding the position of Grand Councilor yet having no land on which to build towers and terraces; serving as Prefect of Chengdu and setting aside even one's tortoise and crane; and even returning from the Southern Sea without carrying a single item in one's baggage, or returning from Western Shu with only a few scrolls—such was the [ethos] of pure integrity…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
風爾也可歷舉其人而實之歟然是
四者則又以誠實為本故議之者則
以推遜恬退清亷者有是非得失真
偽於其間亦可舉其實而言歟此皆
君子律身之要諸士子必覽之熟矣
幸為我陳之
問人臣諫諍非一端也有直諫者有諷
諫者古人有犯顏逆鱗叩頭流血其
===
名曰直宜也而或疑其激和容愉色
微言婉辭其名曰諷宜也而或疑其
佞將置之而不言歟則有愧於其職
將言之而不顧歟則不免於譏議二
者將若之何而可古人有風采聳立
雖鼎鑊不避者謂非直諫可乎有旁
入曲諭雖風雅不過者謂非諷諫得
乎之數君子者上信其心下服其誠
punctuated:
風爾也。可歷舉其人而實之歟？然是四者，則又以誠實為本。故議之者，則以推遜、恬退、清亷者有是非、得失、真偽於其間，亦可舉其實而言歟？此皆君子律身之要，諸士子必覽之熟矣，幸為我陳之。

問：人臣諫諍非一端也，有直諫者，有諷諫者。古人有犯顏逆鱗，叩頭流血，其名曰直，宜也，而或疑其激；和容愉色，微言婉辭，其名曰諷，宜也，而或疑其佞。將置之而不言歟？則有愧於其職；將言之而不顧歟？則不免於譏議。二者將若之何而可？古人有風采聳立，雖鼎鑊不避者，謂非直諫可乎？有旁入曲諭，雖風雅不過者，謂非諷諫得乎？之數君子者，上信其心，下服其誠，
translation_en:
…customs. Can you enumerate the individuals one by one and substantiate these cases? Yet among these four virtues, sincerity and truthfulness are the foundation. Therefore, those who discuss them maintain that among instances of yielding to others, quiet retirement, and incorruptible integrity, there are distinctions of right and wrong, success and failure, and genuineness and falsity; can you also cite the actual facts and speak of them? These are all essential principles by which a gentleman disciplines himself. You scholars must have read about them thoroughly; please set them forth for me.

Question: The ways in which a minister remonstrates with his ruler are not limited to a single mode: there are those who remonstrate directly, and those who remonstrate by indirect admonition. Among the ancients, there were those who braved the ruler's displeasure and stroked the dragon's reverse scales, knocking their heads on the ground until blood flowed; calling this "direct" is fitting, yet some suspect them of being overly vehement. There were those who maintained a gentle countenance and pleasant expression, using subtle words and tactful phrases; calling this "indirect admonition" is fitting, yet some suspect them of being sycophantic. Should one set the matter aside and say nothing? Then one would be ashamed of failing in one's office. Should one speak out without regard for the consequences? Then one cannot escape criticism. Between these two courses, how should one act so that it is proper? Among the ancients, there were those whose noble bearing stood toweringly erect and who did not shrink even from the boiling cauldron—can this be called anything other than direct remonstrance? And there were those who approached a matter obliquely and persuaded through roundabout metaphors, surpassing not even the Airs and Odes (Feng Ya) in subtlety—can this be considered anything other than indirect admonition? As for these several gentlemen, the ruler above trusted their intentions, their peers below submitted to their sincerity,…

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
天下後世知其忠何無一人以譏議
之歟然君聖則臣直今我
聖天子在上百僚庶尹皆知無不言言無不
盡何未見信其心服其誠而知其忠
也其果言者之激與佞歟抑別有其
說歟爾諸生抱藝而來皆將有官守
言責之寄者幸為我言之以觀適用
之學
punctuated: 天下後世知其忠，何無一人以譏議之歟？然君聖則臣直。今我聖天子在上，百僚庶尹，皆知無不言，言無不盡，何未見信其心、服其誠而知其忠也？其果言者之激與佞歟？抑別有其說歟？爾諸生抱藝而來，皆將有官守言責之寄者，幸為我言之，以觀適用之學。
translation_en: …and all under Heaven and later generations knew their loyalty; why was there not a single person who criticized them? Yet when the ruler is sage, his ministers are forthright. Now our sacred Son of Heaven reigns above, and the hundred officials and various administrators all speak of whatever they know and hold nothing back in their speech; why then do we not yet see their intentions trusted, their sincerity admired, and their loyalty recognized? Is it truly because those who speak are either overly strident or sycophantic, or is there some other explanation for it? You students have come bearing your learning and arts, and all of you will in the future be entrusted with official duties or the responsibility to speak out. Please set forth your views for me, so that I may observe your learning suited for practical application.

title: 成化四年廣東鄉試錄
text:
四書義
大宰問於子貢曰夫子聖者與何其多能也子
貢曰固天縱之將聖又多能也
林會
同考試官教諭鄭批此篇場中作者多於大宰所
問聖字直至生知安行為講此卷
獨以多能為聖深合本旨錄出以
為學者式
考試官教諭陳批文簡理精一覽得之
===
考試官教諭張批體認親切可取
時臣以夫子之聖專乎藝大賢言夫子之聖兼乎藝
蓋多能乃聖人餘事耳然天縱聖德豈直多藝能而
已哉宜乎大賢推言以告時臣也昔大宰問於子貢
若曰惟聖多才夫子其聖者歟不然何其才之多至
於釣弋之類亦皆無所不通也惟聖多能夫子其聖
人歟不然何其能之多至於獵較之類亦皆無所不
通也大宰之問如此蓋以多能為聖舉末而遺本矣
子貢荅之意謂思而得者若天限量之也夫子則不
punctuated:
四書義

「大宰問於子貢曰：『夫子聖者與？何其多能也！』子貢曰：『固天縱之將聖，又多能也。』」

林會

同考試官教諭鄭批：此篇場中作者，多於大宰所問「聖」字直至「生知安行」為講；此卷獨以「多能為聖」，深合本旨，錄出以為學者式。
考試官教諭陳批：文簡理精，一覽得之。
考試官教諭張批：體認親切，可取。

時臣以夫子之聖專乎藝，大賢言夫子之聖兼乎藝。蓋多能乃聖人餘事耳，然天縱聖德，豈直多藝能而已哉？宜乎大賢推言以告時臣也。昔大宰問於子貢，若曰：惟聖多才，夫子其聖者歟？不然，何其才之多，至於釣弋之類，亦皆無所不通也！惟聖多能，夫子其聖人歟？不然，何其能之多，至於獵較之類，亦皆無所不通也！大宰之問如此，蓋以多能為聖，舉末而遺本矣。子貢荅之意，謂思而得者，若天限量之也；夫子則不
translation_en:
Expositions on the Four Books

"A Great Officer asked Zigong, 'Is the Master a sage? How is it that he has so many abilities!' Zigong said, 'Certainly Heaven has endowed him without limit so that he is a great sage, and moreover he has many abilities.'" [Analects 9.6]

By Lin Hui 林會

Comment by Associate Examiner and Instructor Zheng 鄭: Among the authors in the examination hall writing on this topic, most expounded the word "sage" in the Great Officer's question by going straight to "knowing through birth and practicing with ease." This paper alone treats it as "taking many abilities to be what makes a sage," which deeply accords with the original purport of the passage. It is selected and recorded to serve as a model for scholars.
Comment by Examiner and Instructor Chen 陳: The writing is concise and the reasoning precise; one grasps it at a single glance.
Comment by Examiner and Instructor Zhang 張: Its personal comprehension of the text is intimate and apt; it is worthy of selection.

A contemporary minister took the Master's sagehood to consist solely in practical skills, whereas the great worthy [Zigong] stated that the Master's sagehood encompassed practical skills as well. Indeed, having many abilities is merely a secondary matter for a sage; yet when Heaven endows someone without limit with sagely virtue, how could it merely be a matter of having many skills and abilities? Fitting it was that the great worthy extended his explanation to inform the contemporary minister.

Formerly, the Great Officer asked Zigong, as if to say: "Only a sage has many talents; is the Master perhaps a sage? Otherwise, how is it that his talents are so numerous that even in matters such as angling and shooting with a corded arrow, there is nothing he does not thoroughly understand! Only a sage has many abilities; is the Master perhaps a sage? Otherwise, how is it that his abilities are so numerous that even in matters such as competing for game in the hunt, there is nothing he does not thoroughly understand!" Such was the Great Officer's question; he took having many abilities to be what makes a sage, citing the branches while overlooking the root.
